assumptions: Tm is Biopython's Tm_NN over the Allawi and SantaLucia 1997 table at the stated conditions.
limits: The fast solver approximates; only the exhaustive one searches every option.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which overlapping primer pairs, one per site, carry a degenerate codon at every site in one reaction?

description: Design site-saturation mutagenesis (SSM) primers: one overlapping forward/reverse pair per site, each carrying a degenerate codon, sharing ONE reaction-level overlap and 3' temperature so every site amplifies in the same tube (both of Mutation Maker's solvers: fast approximation by default, exhaustive search on request). Every Tm is Biopython's `Tm_NN` over the Allawi & SantaLucia 1997 nearest-neighbour table (`DNA_NN3`, upstream's own), under the salt correction and buffer below. A design/write.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

cds.description: the CDS nucleotide sequence, in frame from the start codon (length must be a multiple of 3).

compute_hairpin_homodimer.description: add the hairpin/homodimer/heterodimer penalty to the score (roughly doubles the run; off upstream). Advanced.

degenerate_codon.description: the degenerate codon installed at every site (NNK is the common 32-codon choice).

dnac1.description: the higher-concentration strand (the primer, in a large excess). In nM. Advanced.

dnac2.description: the lower-concentration strand (the template). In nM. Advanced.

dntp.description: total dNTP concentration, which chelates magnesium and so lowers the effective Mg²⁺. In mM. Advanced.

exclude_flanking_primers.description: take the 3' Tm window from the explicit min/max above instead of from the flanking pair's own Tm. Advanced.

five_end_flank.description: explicit 5' flanking sequence — only for a free-standing gene with no plasmid open, and then the 3' flank is required too. Advanced.

forward_primer.description: 5' flanking primer, 5'→3'. Left empty, it is read off the open plasmid 56 bp either side of the CDS (22 nt, and only when it occurs there exactly once).

gc_content_weight.description: score weight on GC overflow. Upstream's default is 0, and its GC term counts G twice and never counts C (a reproduced bug, see the port header) — raising this weight makes that quirk observable. Advanced.

hairpin_temperature_weight.description: score weight on hairpin Tm. Only applies when compute_hairpin_homodimer is true. Advanced.

max_five_end_size.description: longest 5' arm before the mutated codon. In nt. Only applies when solver is exhaustive. Advanced.

max_overlap_size.description: longest overlap. Upstream's scan stops two short of this (a reproduced quirk, see the port header). In nt. Advanced.

max_primer_size.description: longest whole primer. In nt. Advanced.

max_three_end_size.description: longest 3' arm beyond the mutated codon. Bounds the search area and discards candidates whose 3' arm overruns it. In nt. Only applies when solver is exhaustive. Advanced.

mg.description: magnesium concentration — the term the Owczarzy corrections are most sensitive to. In mM. Advanced.

min_five_end_size.description: shortest 5' arm before the mutated codon. In nt. Advanced.

min_gc_content.description: lowest primer GC accepted before a primer is flagged out of range. In %. Advanced.

min_overlap_size.description: shortest shared overlap. In nt. Advanced.

min_overlap_temperature.description: lowest overlap Tm the reaction may settle on. In °C.

min_primer_size.description: shortest whole primer. In nt. Advanced.

min_three_end_size.description: shortest 3' arm beyond the mutated codon. In nt. Advanced.

min_three_end_temperature.description: lowest 3'-end Tm (used when `exclude_flanking_primers` is on; otherwise the window comes from the flanking pair). In °C. Only applies when exclude_flanking_primers is true.

na.description: sodium concentration the salt correction is computed for. In mM. Advanced.

oligo_prefix.description: prefix for the designed oligo names. Advanced.

overlap_temp_range.description: width of the overlap Tm window. In °C. Advanced.

overlap_temp_range_step.description: step between overlap temperatures tried. In °C. Advanced.

overlap_temp_weight.description: score weight on overlap Tm deviation. Advanced.

precision.description: decimal places the reported Tm is rounded to. In dp. Advanced.

primer_dimer_temperature_weight.description: score weight on homo/heterodimer Tm. Only applies when compute_hairpin_homodimer is true. Advanced.

reverse_primer.description: 3' flanking primer, 5'→3' on its own strand. Left empty, it is read off the open plasmid 56 bp either side of the CDS (22 nt, and only when it occurs there exactly once).

salt_correction.description: salt-correction method, in Biopython's `saltcorr` order. Values: No (None), Schildkraut_1965 (Schildkraut & Lifson 1965 (16.6 · log[Na⁺])), Wetmur_1991 (Wetmur 1991 (16.6 · log[Na⁺/(1 + 0.7 · Na⁺)])), SantaLucia_1996 (SantaLucia 1996 (12.5 · log[Na⁺])), SantaLucia_1998 (SantaLucia 1998 (11.7 · log[Na⁺])), SantaLucia_DeltaS_1998 (SantaLucia 1998, entropy (corrects ΔS, not Tm)), Owczarzy_2004 (Owczarzy 2004 (GC-dependent, corrects 1/Tm)), Owczarzy_2008 (Owczarzy 2008 (Mg²⁺ decision tree, dNTP-corrected)). Advanced.

separate_forward_reverse_temperatures.description: optimise the forward and reverse 3' temperatures independently. Advanced.

sites.description: the saturation sites, comma- or space-separated, as [WT][pos]X — e.g. "V2X, K107X". 1-based residue positions.

solver.description: which of Mutation Maker's two solvers designs the pairs. `fast` grows one candidate per site per temperature combination (upstream's own default, milliseconds). `exhaustive` enumerates every primer of every allowed length at every allowed start and scores every geometrically valid pair — hundreds of thousands per site, seconds rather than milliseconds, and it reports what it searched. Values: fast (Fast approximation), exhaustive (Exhaustive search).

three_end_flank.description: explicit 3' flanking sequence, the partner of `five_end_flank`. Advanced.

three_end_size_weight.description: score weight on 3'-end length deviation. Advanced.

three_end_temp_range.description: width of the 3'-end Tm window scanned around each candidate temperature. In °C. Advanced.

three_end_temp_range_step.description: step between 3'-end temperatures tried. In °C. Advanced.

three_end_temp_weight.description: score weight on 3'-end Tm deviation. Advanced.

name: design_saturation_primers

foundCount.description: sites the solver found a pair for (< siteCount means the parameters were too tight for some)

fullSequence.description: the construct the design spans, flanking primer to flanking primer

overlapTemperature.description: the ONE overlap Tm the whole reaction settled on

pairs.description: one designed forward/reverse pair per site, with its overlap, temperatures, GC and in-range flags

search.description: what the solver actually searched: candidates enumerated and kept, pairs scored, temperature combinations tried. Null for the fast solver, which enumerates nothing
